name: listEvents
description: Returns events, most imminent first. Safe: calling this changes nothing, and callers (including caches and crawlers) may rely on that.

name: createReservation
description: Creates a reservation. NOT safe and not naturally idempotent, which is why the Idempotency-Key header is required: a repeated request carrying the same key and the same body is recognized as a repeat and answered with the stored outcome of the first attempt, applied exactly once. Keys are retained for at least 24 hours. A timed-out caller MUST retry with the same key; retrying with a fresh key creates a second reservation.

Idempotency-Key.description: A unique client-generated token identifying this attempt (a UUID is fine). The scope of "same request" is this key plus the request body.

annotations.consequence: takes a scarce seat; visible to a human at a door

name: getReservation
description: The recovery path: a caller that lost a reply (or its idempotency key) can ask what happened instead of guessing.
